posts.body:
Was browsing the BBC website and came across this article about William and Kate receiving a Finnish baby box.

This is what every expectant mum in Finland receives - its amazing!

http://www.bbc.co.uk/news/blogs-magazine-monitor-23138306

Could you ever, ever see that happening here?
